Antwerp: De Beers just cut a full tray diamond scan from 30 minutes to under five with SynthDetect 2, its newest screening tool.

De Beers Group's Science & Technology division showed it at Hong Kong's Gem & Jewellery Show on 15 September; it screens more diamond types and jewellery, stones already set included.

Antwerpen: De Beers verkort een traycontrole van dertig minuten naar minder dan vijf met SynthDetect 2, het nieuwste controle-instrument.

Antwerp: gold fell to €118,90 a gram on Tuesday's tape, down 1.39%, as traders wait on the Fed's rate call.

Kitco's spot read $4,267.30 an ounce and the ECB's euro rate was 1.1539; silver fell 1.79% to €1.753,40 a kilogram. RAPI held near flat at €3.383,70 a carat.

Antwerpen: goud daalde naar €118,90 per gram, een daling van 1,39%, in afwachting van de Fed.
